questions.stem: A line of best fit should pass through or close to:
questions.explanation: A line of best fit should pass through the mean point $(\bar{x}, \bar{y})$, with roughly equal numbers of data points above and below the line.

questions.stem: Using a line of best fit to estimate a value within the range of the data is called:
questions.explanation: Interpolation is estimating within the data range. It is generally reliable because the trend is supported by data in that region.

options.text: The trend may not continue beyond the data range
The line of best fit is always wrong
You cannot draw lines beyond the graph

questions.explanation: Extrapolation extends the line beyond the observed data. The relationship may change outside the data range, making predictions unreliable.

questions.stem: A line of best fit passes through $(2, 30)$ and $(8, 72)$. What is the gradient?
When drawing a line of best fit, you should:

options.text: Connect every point with straight lines
Draw a curve through the points
Draw a straight line with roughly equal points above and below, ignoring outliers
Always start the line at the origin

questions.explanation: A line of best fit is a single straight line that follows the general trend, with roughly equal data points above and below it. Outliers should be ignored.

questions.stem: Data covers ages 10 to 16. A student uses the line of best fit to predict a value at age 25. This prediction is:

options.text: An example of extrapolation and is unreliable
Reliable because the line is accurate

questions.explanation: Age 25 is well outside the data range (10--16), making this extrapolation. The trend may not continue, so the prediction is unreliable.

questions.stem: The equation of a line of best fit for height ($x$ cm) vs weight ($y$ kg) is $y = 0.8x - 62$. The gradient $0.8$ means:

options.text: For every 1 cm increase in height, weight increases by about 0.8 kg

questions.explanation: The gradient represents the rate of change: for each additional 1 cm of height, the model predicts weight increases by approximately 0.8 kg.
